name: Hero Splendor
description:
The Hero Splendor remains a staple in the commuter segment due to its highly reliable 97.2cc engine and exceptional structural durability. It features a tubular double-cradle frame that offers excellent stability while remaining lightweight enough for effortless maneuvering through congested urban areas.

Specifications:
* Engine: 97.2cc, Air-Cooled
* Power: 7.91 bhp
* Torque: 8.05 Nm
* Transmission: 4-Speed
* Weight: 112 kg
* Tank: 9.8L
